description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, specifically USD, with dynamic precision, optional credits suffix, and fallback formatting. It includes functions for formatting currency with optional credits, formatting USD with up to six decimals, and ensures consistent display across the application.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with optional credits suffix, handling dynamic decimal precision based on the value's magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amount with credits appended, defaulting to include credits.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with up to six decimal places and thousands separators.
